text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Start: 2026-03-14T14:02:14Z. Symptoms: burst of 429s followed by 502/504s. Auto-page to oncall.
Priya Desai: I'm on it. Can someone grab initial triage? Do we have a suspected deploy?
Jess Carter: seeing 429 spikes starting ~14:01, then upstream 502s at 14:05. Dashboard: per-route 429 -> backend saturation. Quick snapshot: 429s are concentrated on the public API gateway, mostly requests with large seq lengths.
Marco Li: I deployed a rate-limit/quota change at 13:58 to tighten global token buckets for self-serve tenants (rollout 50%). Could be related.
Sam Ortiz: logs from gateway show quota_rejected + retry floods. Upstream service (inference-proxy) shows connection queue full -> 502. It looks like rate limit misconfig created a tight 429 throttle that triggered client retries and overloaded internal pools.
Nina Gomez: Support is getting customer reports about timeouts and 5xx for embeddings/generate calls. 3 customers reported degraded UX, PSA being composed.
Priya Desai: OK that's consistent. Priority: mitigate customer impact first. Two options: rollback rate-limit change, or open higher quota for affected routes plus apply stricter retry backoff at gateway. Thoughts?
Marco Li: rollback is fastest. I can rollback the feature flag to 0% in config-service. Doing it now: `curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/ratelimit_rollout -d '{"percent":0}'`
Marco Li: rolled back to 0% at 14:10 UTC.
incident-bot: Noted rollback action by Marco Li at 14:10:22Z.
Sam Ortiz: After rollback, still seeing continued 429s due to token bucket counters on gateway nodes — they need to be reset or service restarted to stop stale throttles.
infra-oncall: I'm rebooting the gateway pods one by one to flush counters and apply new config. Will do a rolling restart across us-west-2, then eu-west-1. ETA ~8-10 mins.
Jess Carter: Adding a temporary config to suppress client retries at the gateway for 30s to reduce retry storms: `gateway.retry.policy.max_retries=1` and `gateway.retry.backoff_ms=250` pushed to all edge nodes.
Priya Desai: Good. Nina, please draft customer-facing note: limited impact, mitigation in progress, ETA 20 min.
Nina Gomez: On it. Draft: "We've identified a rate-limit configuration issue that caused elevated errors for API requests. We've rolled back the change and are restarting edge nodes; service should recover shortly. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
Sam Ortiz: Metrics update: error rate fell ~60% after gateway restart in us-west-2 at 14:18, but eu-west-1 still elevated. Rolling restart in eu-west-1 in progress.
infra-oncall: eu-west-1 restarts complete at 14:23 UTC.
incident-bot: System metrics show 5xx rate returning to baseline between 14:20-14:25.
Marco Li: Confirmed rollback removed the faulty quota enforcement rule. Need to audit the release validation that allowed a global bucket change without canary for high-traffic routes.
Priya Desai: Customer impact summary so far? Nina?
Nina Gomez: 7 customers opened support tickets, 3 reported API timeouts >30s, no data loss, most intermittent failures. SRE outreach email queued for affected customers (list attached to ticket #INC-9532).
Jess Carter: Post-mitigation checks: ran `curl -s -D- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -o /dev/null` against multiple regions — 200 responses now, latency back to normal ~120ms median.
Sam Ortiz: Also verified upstream pool metrics: connection queues drained, error budgets recovered.
infra-oncall: Followups: 1) add gate in deploy pipeline that prevents global rate-limit changes from reaching >10% rollout without per-route canary; 2) add a script to reset token buckets without pod restarts; 3) dashboard to correlate 429 -> increased client retries -> 5xx.
Priya Desai: +1 on all. Assign owners: Marco for deploy pipeline guard, Sam for token-bucket reset script, Jess for the dashboard query and alert refinement. Please add to the incident board.
Marco Li: I'll open a PR for the pipeline check and schedule a canary-only rollout pattern.
Sam Ortiz: I'll prototype an admin endpoint `POST /admin/gateway/reset_buckets` (auth-only) and test on staging.
Jess Carter: Dashboard query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)` correlated with `sum(rate(gateway_retries_total[1m]))` — will add a composite alert to warn when both climb together.
Priya Desai: Any further mitigations required right now?
Marco Li: No, system health looks stable. Keeping thread open for the postmortem and customer comms.
Nina Gomez: Sent the customer outreach at 14:40 UTC to the impacted list.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated" at 14:45:03Z by Priya Desai.
Priya Desai: Great work team. Immediate actions done. We'll run a blameless postmortem and push the pipeline guard in next sprint and prioritize token bucket admin. Assign follow-ups in the incident tracker.
Jess Carter: Notes for postmortem: timeline, config diff (ratelimit rule id rl-2026-0314), why rollout allowed 50% globally, missing canary for public route, recommend circuit breaker and retry budget.
Sam Ortiz: Also recommend adding automated rollback when 429->5xx cascade detected within a short window.
Marco Li: I'll include a safer default for the rate-limit config and add an internal checklist for quota changes.
Priya Desai: Closing thread for active mitigation. Leave open for postmortem write-up. :white_check_mark:
